verdict.rationale: Brex markets built-in AI assistants that do employees' expenses for them: writing memos, fetching receipts, giving policy help and filing reimbursements. It also describes audit and review agents that auto-approve, escalate and follow up, and Brex AI drafts bill payments; a community commenter independently lists 'AI assistants for all users.' One commenter calls the AI products 'gimmickry', but that is general skepticism, not a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how users delegate free-form tasks to the assistant (interface, scope, limits), and hands-on corroboration that delegation works as marketed.
